notifications.name: Tegami
notifications.author: Ryoku Team
notifications.description: Each notification arrives as a small letter: sender and time above an editorial headline, the app seal beside the message, a quiet row of actions, a vermilion edge for urgent ones and a hairline that drains while it waits.

notifications.name: Island
notifications.author: Alan Betty
notifications.description: A black card with the app icon or the sender's picture, the summary, body and time, and liquid glass only where your hand goes: a close bead on hover and glass action pills. Urgent notifications carry a Time Sensitive line and a red halo; timed cards drain a hairline along the foot.
